policies.name: case_medication_read
policies.using:
(EXISTS ( SELECT
   FROM ((msa.review_cases c
     LEFT JOIN msa.medication_schedules s ON ((s.id = c.schedule_id)))
     LEFT JOIN msa.safety_assessments a ON ((a.id = c.safety_assessment_id)))
  WHERE ((c.user_id = medication_entry_versions.user_id) AND msa.can_access_case(c.id, c.user_id) AND ((s.entry_version_id = medication_entry_versions.id) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT
           FROM msa.snapshot_entries se
          WHERE ((se.snapshot_id = a.snapshot_id) AND (se.entry_version_id = medication_entry_versions.id))))))))

jsonb_contracts.review_and_consent: msa.domain_evidence: schema tag and nonempty sources containing locator and SHA-256
jsonb_contracts.health_fact_value: Exact value/text/uncertainty projection of source_content.facts[source_fact_index]; checked by domain_guard
jsonb_contracts.schedule: msa.valid_schedule: schedule.v1, distinct HH:MM local times, nonempty dose_raw; IANA timezone column
jsonb_contracts.schedule_verification: schedule-verification.v1: exact schedule_digest + entry_digest, explicit=true, confirmation_key UUID; HCP review_outcome_id when required; patient confirmation requires exact clock/dose pairs from original administrations
jsonb_contracts.notification_preferences: notification-preferences.v1 with IN_APP or BROWSER channel; storage only, no delivery service
jsonb_contracts.summary_sections: Allowed section keys must exist in immutable summary; msa.shared_summary returns only permitted sections
jsonb_contracts.business_audit: business-audit.v1, nullable reason, previous/current row digests; no duplicated patient payload

identity_registry.ownership: Same UUID as Auth.users.user_id; local Core registry, not an account/role copy. No cross-database FK.
